title: PUGG 6' Pop-Up Soccer Goals (Pair)

comparisons.notes: PUGG 6ft Pugg Goals (Pair), 6'W x 3.5'H x 3.5'D, 2 goals, carry bag and spare parts kit; sale $119.95, no sold-out label.
The Original 6 Footer (Pair), same 6'x3.5'x3.5' pair with bag and attached pegs; no out-of-stock notice.
Pugg 6 Footer Pop-Up Portable Soccer Goals, two goals, carry bag and pegs; no sold-out notice.

writeup: Woot has a new pair of PUGG 6-foot pop-up soccer goals (model PS1) for $59.99. You get two 6' x 3.5' x 3.5' goals, pegs and a carry bag, and they twist down flat for storage. Goals4Sports sells the same pair for $119.95 and Pugg's own site charges $129.95, so this is about half the going rate.
